headline: True-positive attack from 91.132.147.22 led to managed identity token theft and confirmed mailbox data access
summary: Between 2026-07-17 23:06:13 and 2026-07-17 23:06:26, a confirmed malicious attack from 91.132.147.22 progressed from password spraying against three accounts to successful IMDS token acquisition on webapp-vm-001 and mailbox item access in procurement@contoso.com. Sensitive data access/exfiltration was confirmed. Total observable events: 6.

items.title: Incident verdict
items.detail: Incident classified as True Positive / Other with high confidence because a confirmed malicious attack achieved successful sensitive data access.

items.title: Confirmed data access/exfiltration
items.detail: The report states data access/exfiltration confirmed following mailbox access activity against procurement@contoso.com.

items.title: Observed source IP
items.detail: Public IP 91.132.147.22 was observed in credential access activity and throughout the incident sequence.

items.title: Incident time window
items.detail: Attack activity occurred during the reported incident window.

items.title: Total observable events
items.detail: The report lists 6 total observable events.

items.title: Blast radius summary
items.detail: Three accounts were targeted during password spraying; one mailbox had confirmed items read; one managed identity was compromised; one virtual machine was involved.
items.value: 3 targeted accounts, 1 mailbox accessed, 1 managed identity compromised, 1 VM affected

items.title: Targeted user
items.detail: ap-team@contoso.com was targeted during credential access from 91.132.147.22 using graph-mail-client-id.

items.title: Targeted mailbox
items.detail: procurement@contoso.com was targeted during credential access and later accessed during collection.

items.title: Targeted user
items.detail: vendor-mgmt@contoso.com was targeted during credential access from 91.132.147.22 using graph-mail-client-id.

items.title: Compromised managed identity
items.detail: Managed identity 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555 was compromised via IMDS token retrieval for hxxps://graph[.]microsoft[.]com.

items.title: Affected virtual machine
items.detail: Virtual machine webapp-vm-001 was involved in successful IMDS token access.

items.title: Password spray against multiple accounts
items.detail: At 2026-07-17 23:06:13, 4 failed sign-ins targeted 3 accounts from 91.132.147.22. Alert: IA-ALERT-001. AADSignInLogs showed ResultType 50126 and AuthenticationProtocol=ropc.

items.title: Managed identity token obtained via IMDS
items.detail: At 2026-07-17 23:06:14, IMDS.GetToken succeeded from 91.132.147.22 against webapp-vm-001 for resource hxxps://graph[.]microsoft[.]com using user agent curl/8.5.0. Alert: IA-ALERT-002.

items.title: Mailbox items accessed
items.detail: At 2026-07-17 23:06:18, OfficeActivity recorded MailItemsAccessed with OperationCount=3 for procurement@contoso.com. Alerts: IA-ALERT-003, IA-ALERT-004, IA-ALERT-005, IA-ALERT-006.

items.title: Mailbox items accessed
items.detail: At 2026-07-17 23:06:18, OfficeActivity recorded a second MailItemsAccessed event with OperationCount=3 for procurement@contoso.com.

items.title: Mailbox items accessed
items.detail: At 2026-07-17 23:06:25, OfficeActivity recorded MailItemsAccessed with OperationCount=3 for procurement@contoso.com.

items.title: Mailbox items accessed
items.detail: At 2026-07-17 23:06:26, OfficeActivity recorded MailItemsAccessed with OperationCount=3 for procurement@contoso.com.

items.title: Brute Force: Password Spraying
items.detail: MITRE ATT&CK T1110.003. Evidence comes from AADSignInLogs showing 4 failed sign-ins targeting 3 accounts from 91.132.147.22.

items.title: Unsecured Credentials: Cloud Instance Metadata API
items.detail: MITRE ATT&CK T1552.005. Evidence comes from successful IMDS.GetToken activity against webapp-vm-001 from 91.132.147.22.

items.title: Remote Email Collection
items.detail: MITRE ATT&CK T1114.002. Evidence comes from successful MailItemsAccessed events for procurement@contoso.com.

items.title: Immediate containment priority
items.detail: Prioritize containment around the confirmed source IP 91.132.147.22, compromised managed identity 11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555, affected VM webapp-vm-001, and accessed mailbox procurement@contoso.com.
items.value: contain source, identity, VM, and mailbox

items.title: Determination category is broad
items.detail: The report determination is 'Other'; no narrower incident determination is provided in the source.
